{{Quote|Certainly, after Tarkin's death, the academies on Eriadu and Phelarion became home to a great number of the children of Coruscant's wealthy elite, who wanted the honor attached to Tarkin's memory and reputation but who displayed none of his military instinct.|Beaumont Kin, ''The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire''|<ref name="Rise" />}}
An '''Imperial Academy''' was located on<ref name="Rise" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]]<ref name="Appendix">{{GalaxyMapAppendix}} — Based on corresponding data for the [[Phelarion system]]</ref> astronomical object [[Phelarion]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. After Imperial [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] [[Death|perished]] during the [[Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Rise" /> many of the [[Youngling|children]] of the wealthy elite of the Imperial [[capital]], [[Coruscant]], were sent to the [[Imperial Academy|academy]] by their families, who hoped to claim some of the honor attached to Tarkin's reputation and memory. The [[historian]] [[Beaumont Kin]] claimed the [[Coruscanti]] students lacked Tarkin's military instinct in<ref name="Rise" /> his<ref name="TROSVD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[book]] ''[[The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''<ref name="Rise" /> in [[35 ABY]].<ref name="RiseDate">{{RiseAndFallDate}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Academy on Phelarion was mentioned in the [[2024]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'', which was written by Dr. [[Chris Kempshall]].<ref name="Rise" />
